أعتني (form VIII)
# أَعْتَنِي (ʔaʕtanī) /ʔaʕ.ta.niː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
# أَعْتَنِيَ (ʔaʕtaniya) /ʔaʕ.ta.ni.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَنَى (iʕtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
